child_list.content: What Do You Want To Be?
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content:
When you grow up, grow up.

What do you want to be?

I want to be a teacher. I will teach you.

I want to be a doctor. I will cure you.

I want to be a fireman. I will save you.

Teacher, doctor, fireman,

I like them all.

Teacher, doctor, fireman,

I will choose one.

child_list.content: Hello, hello, hello
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content:
Hello, hello, hello. Hi, hi, hi.

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

It’s a nice day, let’s whistle a tune.

Good evening to you, good evening to you.

It’s wonderful night, let’s dance in the moonlight

child_list.content: 你想成为什么？
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
当你长大了，长大了。

你想成为什么？

我想成为一名老师。我会教你。

我想成为一名医生。我会治愈你。

我想成为一名消防员。我会救你。

老师、医生、消防员，我都喜欢。

老师、医生、消防员，我会选一个。
child_list.name: 文本框

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
